owner_directive: 明显能慢慢 tp，大趋势不要机械止盈，也不要把止盈伪装成抬止损
approved_bundle: Owner authorized autonomous exploration. V6 showed that fixed-price banking truncates audit tails, so V7 changes the release event from price touch to completed-close EMA30 weakness while keeping earned profit milestones and the runner stop frozen.

frozen_entry.contract: Exact V5 K1/K2 morphology and one-signal-per-live-regime ledger.

frozen_execution.gap_stop_fill: bar open when it gaps beyond the active stop
frozen_execution.state_update_timing: EMA weakness and SMA trail calculated at close t become actionable on t+1

weakness_harvest.release_condition: after at least one slot is earned, a completed close on the adverse side of EMA30 while the close is net-profitable releases at most one pending stage
weakness_harvest.fill: next bar open; if the open gaps through the active stop, stop has priority
weakness_harvest.consecutive_weak_closes: one additional earned stage may be released per confirmed weak close
weakness_harvest.remainder: unchanged SMA60 minus direction times one current ATR runner

selection.rank: Among arms meeting every gate, maximize robust half-year net bp and then preserve more runner. If none pass, retain the baseline and report failure.
selection.audit_rule: Audit only the development-selected stage fraction when every gate passes.
